observed_mechanics: 0x006a1de0-0x006a1de3: PUSH ESI, MOV ESI,ECX, then MOVZX EAX,byte ptr [ESI+0x2c] loads the zero-extended mode byte.
0x006a1de7/0x006a1deb: EDX takes the +0x18 word and EDI takes the +0x1c word.
0x006a1def: LEA ECX,[ESP+0x10] with four words already pushed forms the address of this frame's own id stack slot, which is the third argument of the direct call.
0x006a1dee-0x006a1df5: four pushes in the order mode byte, id slot address, +0x1c word, +0x18 word; the callee therefore sees (entries_begin=+0x18, entries_end=+0x1c, id pointer, lookup mode).
0x006a1df6: CALL 0x00612db0 is the only direct call; 0x006a1dff ADD ESP,0x10 pops its four arguments, which fixes the callee as a cdecl function of three live arguments plus one dead word.

0x006a1dfb: EDX is reloaded from the caller's id stack slot after the call; the reload is a register reload, not an observable mutation, because the 33-instruction body of 0x00612db0 only reads the id pointer and never writes through it.
0x006a1e02/0x006a1e04: CMP EAX,EDI with JZ treats a returned end pointer as a miss.
0x006a1e06/0x006a1e08: CMP EDX,[EAX] with JC is an unsigned comparison of the id against the entry key at offset 0, so an id strictly below the key is also a miss.
0x006a1e0a-0x006a1e0f: LEA ECX,[EAX+0x18] and CMP EAX,ECX/JNZ maps a self-offset sentinel node onto the end pointer; the stride 0x18 is the entry size.
0x006a1e11: all three miss tests converge on MOV EAX,EDI, which substitutes the +0x1c end pointer.
0x006a1e17-0x006a1e1f: the out pointer is reloaded from the caller frame, EAX is advanced by 4 and that ADDRESS is stored through the out pointer; the dword stored inside the entry is never loaded.
0x006a1e21: MOV AL,0x1 fixes the hit-path return byte.
0x006a1e27-0x006a1e2c: the +0x30 word is loaded and tested; a null word diverts to 0x006a1e40.

0x006a1e2e-0x006a1e39: otherwise [ECX] is loaded as a vtable, the out pointer then the id word are pushed, the slot word at displacement 0x20 is loaded into EDX and called with the +0x30 object still in ECX.
0x006a1e3b-0x006a1e3d: the epilogue does not touch AL, so the +0x20 callee's return byte is this function's return byte.
0x006a1e40-0x006a1e44: XOR AL,AL is the no-parent return.

vtables.limit: The table proves function-pointer storage and the slot arithmetic. It does not prove which runtime object supplies this table at the +0x30 field, nor the semantics of the null word at +0x48.

caller_visible_contract.role: prerequisite boundary; 0x006a1e50 App::DirectPropertyList::GetPropertyAlt is deferred behind this record
caller_visible_contract.receiver_validity: The receiver in ECX must be a live object of the modelled class. The body dereferences +0x18, +0x1c, +0x2c unconditionally, so all four words must be readable. A null receiver is not handled and must not be passed.
caller_visible_contract.span_validity: +0x18 and +0x1c are passed to the lookup helper as an ordered span; when they are equal the helper returns +0x18 immediately, which the body then treats as a miss.
caller_visible_contract.arguments: property_id is read only. The body passes the ADDRESS of its own id stack slot to the helper, and the helper only reads through it, so the id is not an in/out parameter and a caller may pass any 32-bit value including 0 and 0xffffffff.

return_semantics.hit: 0x1 when the helper's result is neither the +0x1c end pointer nor a self-offset sentinel and the entry key is not above the id; in that case the out pointer receives the ADDRESS of the entry word at +0x04
return_semantics.miss_with_second_list: AL is whatever the +0x20 implementation of the +0x30 object returns; the body neither writes the out pointer nor inspects the value
return_semantics.miss_without_second_list: 0x0 and the out pointer is left untouched

caller_visible_contract.out_pointer_contract: The caller must pass a writable 4-byte slot. It is written only on the hit path. On both miss paths the body does not touch it, and on the forwarded miss path the callee owns it.
side_effect_order: 1. one cdecl call to 0x00612db0 with the span words, the address of the id word and the mode byte, in that stack order
2. at most one store through the out pointer, on the hit path only
3. at most one thiscall through the +0x20 slot of the +0x30 object, on the miss path only, with the out pointer as the callee's second stack word and the id as its first
caller_visible_contract.reentrancy: The +0x20 forward is a plain call, not a tail jump, so a cycle in the +0x30 chain is not broken by this frame; chain termination is a property of the data, not of this body.
what_a_caller_may_assume: the receiver is not modified by this body in any observed path
the out pointer receives the address of a 4-byte word inside the entry, never a dereferenced property value
a false return never means the out pointer was written
the callee reclaims both stack words, so a caller must not adjust ESP after the call
what_a_caller_must_not_assume: that the entry word at +0x04 is itself a Property pointer; only its address is observable here
that the +0x30 object is the same object as the receiver or a parent of it; only that it answers slots +0x1c and +0x20 with these shapes
that the mode byte at +0x2c influences the outcome

semantic_findings: The function is a sorted-span lookup with a three-test miss refinement and a virtual forward, not a chain walk in this frame: the recursion lives in the +0x20 callee.
0x00612db0 is a shared, class-agnostic unsigned lower bound over a 0x18-stride array; the class contributes only the span words and the key position inside the entry.
The id is passed by address to the helper purely so the helper can read the key from the caller's frame; it is not an in/out parameter, so the reload at 0x006a1dfb is a register reload.
The mode byte at +0x2c is pushed and then ignored by the only callee that receives it, so it is dead in this body.
The hit path hands the caller the ADDRESS of the entry word at +0x04, which is why the out parameter is a pointer-to-pointer in the SDK signature; the stored value is never loaded here.

The self-offset guard at 0x006a1e0a maps a node equal to node+0x18 onto the miss sentinel; no valid 32-bit pointer can satisfy that identity, so the guard is unreachable for a well-formed span and is reproduced as an inert check.
The forwarded miss path returns the callee's AL untouched, so the bool of this function is a union of the local hit test and the delegated implementation's own result.

corroborating_staging_analogue.note: That package already models this VA with the same field offsets, the same three-branch miss test and the same parent forward, but inlines the lower bound instead of calling the shared helper. This package keeps the direct call to 0x00612db0 behind a named cdecl port and adds the argument order, the dead mode word and the address-only hit store that the inline version cannot show. That package types the entry word at +0x04 as an inline 0x14-byte object; this record claims only the address and leaves the pointee unresolved.

scope.state_policy: The model writes no global or process state; the only store is through the caller's out pointer on the hit path.
